title: Notifications
intro: A socio can notify you when something needs you: unattended work that finished, a problem, a decision only you can make. It goes to the channels you turn on here, and only while you aren’t using $t(common:product). While you are, it shows in the app instead.

content.messageNote: The socio’s name, its message and, where the device shows one, its image.
content.privateNote: Only which socio needs you: the message stays in $t(common:product) until you open it.

push.turnOnFailed: Could not turn notifications on in this browser.
push.notAllowed: Notifications weren’t allowed. Try again and choose Allow.
push.ios: Add $t(common:product) to your Home Screen first, then turn notifications on in the app. On iPhone and iPad, only the installed app gets notifications.
push.unsupported: This browser can’t get push notifications. Try another browser, or Telegram.
push.denied: Notifications are blocked for this site in your browser’s settings. Allow them there, then reload this page.

test.title: Test
test.description: Sends a test now to every channel that’s on, even while you’re here.
test.none: No channel is on, so nothing was sent. Turn one on above.
test.failed: Could not send the test notification.

issues.title: Issue subscriptions
issues.intro: Get one notice when all chosen issues reach a status after a future change. Existing matches are not announced. Device delivery uses your notification channels above; a notice also appears in $t(common:product).
issues.alreadyMatched: These issues already match. No historical notice was sent; this waits for a later transition.
issues.subscribed: Subscribed. You will be notified once when all these issues match.
